subject: Training on customer data - opt-out confirmation
body:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@acmefin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Apr 28, 2027 at 15:12 -0700
Subject: RE: Discovery call recap + data handling follow-ups (training opt-out)

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re all aligned on next steps related to training-on-customer-data and data handling requirements: 

- Your ask: Acme Finance will opt out of any model improvement/training that uses customer-provided data or PII.
- Data residency: All inference for Acme will remain in us-west-2.
- Logging controls: We discussed redaction options and minimizing retention for request bodies.
- Audit evidence: you requested a signed opt-out form + our SOC2 / evidence pointers.

Action items:
1) I’ll send the formal opt-out form and a DocuSign link for signature (Marissa).
2) Rishi will follow up with a short note on logging/PII handling and recommended retention windows.
3) Priyom can provide a runbook for how we configure a dedicated route that disables training-on-customer-data at the tenant level.

If that matches what you heard, reply here and we’ll kick off the same-day paperwork.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com

---

From: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@acmefin.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Acme Finance Security <security@acmefin.com>
Date: Thu, Apr 29, 2027 at 09:03 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery call recap + data handling follow-ups (training opt-out)

Hi Neha —

Thanks for the clear recap. Confirming Acme Finance will opt out of model training on any data we send to Redwood (including PII and inferred identifiers). We also need confirmation that:

- Logs do not retain full request bodies longer than 30 days (we’re fine with short-term ephemeral logs for troubleshooting if they can be redacted).
- No payloads are used for model improvement or analytics.
- Data locality: processing must remain in us-west-2 for all production routes.

Can you send the opt-out form and the DocuSign link? Also copying our security inbox for the paperwork.

Appreciate it —
Jordan Ellis
Director, Product — Acme Finance
jordan.ellis@acmefin.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0123

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@acmefin.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Apr 29, 2027 at 11:28 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery call recap + data handling follow-ups (training opt-out)

Jordan —

Looping in the docs you requested. Attached: a short opt-out form for training-on-customer-data (PDF) and a copy of our security questionnaire with the fields you flagged. I’ve also created a DocuSign envelope for signature: https://www.docusign.com/transaction/tx123456 (link expires in 7 days). 

What I’m sending you here:
- acme_train_optout.pdf (attachment) — this is the formal opt-out statement we add to your tenant config.
- acme_security_questionnaire.xlsx (attachment) — latest answers to your security checklist.
- HubSpot deal link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/123456789 (for your PM/Secops reference)

Next steps from Redwood: 
1) Jordan signs the opt-out via DocuSign (or replies with approval).
2) Once signed, we’ll update provisioning to ensure the tenant route is set to opt-out for model training and flag it to infra.
3) Rishi will share the recommended logging retention config and a short note on redaction best practices.
4) Laura (CS) will schedule a handoff for production enablement.

Attaching the files to this thread (see PDF/XLSX).

Thanks — ping me if you want the legal team looped.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Phone: +1 650-555-0199

Attachments: acme_train_optout.pdf (PDF, 1 page), acme_security_questionnaire.xlsx (XLSX)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@acmefin.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Apr 30, 2027 at 09:45 -0700
Subject: RE: Logging/redaction + retention for Acme Finance

Hi Jordan —

Following up on the logging and PII controls:

Summary of controls we’ll apply for Acme Finance after opt-out is signed:
- Training-on-customer-data: disabled at tenant level — no payloads will be included in any model improvement pipelines.
- Request logging: request metadata (timestamp, route id, token consumption) retained for 90 days by default; request bodies are redacted immediately unless explicitly enabled for debugging. We can set bodies to 30 days retention for your account as requested.
- PII handling: Redwood will apply automated redaction rules (emails, SSNs, credit card patterns) at the edge. Any unstructured PII that may remain can be masked by your side prior to ingest.
- Audit evidence: upon signature we’ll provide a signed opt-out PDF and a short statement of controls for your audit folder.

If 30 days for request body retention works, confirm and we’ll roll that in with the tenant config change.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com

Signed the opt-out (attached). 30 days request-body retention is acceptable. Please proceed with tenant-level opt-out config and confirm once applied.

Jordan Ellis
